subject: Popup a Plot when datatable Cell Clicked

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Popup a Plot when datatable Cell Clicked
parts: Is it possible to implement clicking on a table cell having the effect of creating a popup of a graph ? For example, the table could be a table of correlation coefficients. When a cell is clicked, a popup area could appear with a scatterplot of the two variables that the coefficient was calculated with.

messages.subject: Re: Popup a Plot when datatable Cell Clicked
parts:
When you click on a cell, you can obtain its row and column indices in
Shiny. Look for "tableId_cell_clicked" on this page:
http://rstudio.github.io/DT/shiny.html Once you have got the row and
column indices, it is up to you what to do next. Note this feature
requires the development version of DT: https://github.com/rstudio/DT

Regards,
Yihui
